meta.warning: Industry scores are opportunity hypotheses based on current evidence. City-industry intersection scores combine independently researched city context with industry evidence and are explicitly composite until local industry evidence is added.
meta.formula: base = sum(metric/5 * weight); score = base - risk penalty; priority = score * (0.86 + 0.028 * confidence)
meta.intersectionFormula: city-industry composite = 70% industry profile + 30% city affinity context

industries.name: Architecture / AEC design
industries.summary: Thin margins, fee pressure, project information overload and construction-administration work make judgment-preserving automation unusually interesting.

industries.name: Medicine / healthcare delivery
industries.summary: Administrative burden, fragmented care workflows and high-value professional time create enormous leverage, with equally high trust and regulatory barriers.

industries.name: Construction / trades
industries.summary: Labor scarcity, field-office coordination, project delays and expensive documentation failures create frequent operational pain.

industries.name: Restaurants / hospitality
industries.summary: Very thin margins turn small improvements in labor, purchasing, waste and demand forecasting into meaningful survival economics.

industries.name: Legal services
industries.summary: AI is compressing time-based work while governance, pricing, knowledge retrieval and billing systems lag behind the new production model.

industries.name: Accounting / tax
industries.summary: AI-driven workflow change, talent readiness, seasonal workload and repetitive client-document operations create strong automation opportunities.

industries.name: Property management / real-estate operations
industries.summary: Maintenance, insurance, compliance, resident communication and turnover combine high workflow frequency with fragmented vendors and systems.

industries.name: Education
industries.summary: Teacher workload, behavior, absenteeism and AI-era assessment integrity create severe pain but public-sector buying and outcomes complicate monetization.

industries.name: Logistics / transportation
industries.summary: Detention, visibility gaps, labor constraints and exception-heavy coordination make real-time workflow intelligence valuable at scale.

industries.name: Manufacturing
industries.summary: Downtime, OT resilience, quality systems, workforce knowledge and interoperability attach software decisions directly to physical production value.

industries.name: Retail / commerce
industries.summary: Returns, fraud, inventory accuracy and omnichannel operations create enormous data-rich loss pools with clear financial feedback loops.

industries.name: Professional software / technology
industries.summary: AI adoption is high but trust, verification, toolchain complexity and engineering wait time create a new layer of developer-experience pain.
